Description

7NUTRITION ZMB + GMC 90caps
The most powerful and comprehensive night regeneration supplement.

3 capsules used before bedtime provide:

increase in own testosterone production due to the combination of Zinc, Magnesium and Vitamin B6
increase in growth hormone production
profound and lasting sleep thanks to the synergy of ingredients: GABA + Melatonin
increasing the level of glutathione, the most potent protective substance in our body, thanks to Cysteine ​​and Vitamin E
An essential night supplement from now on, in a comprehensive formula of 7 ingredients.
Zinc, Magnesium, B6

The combination of Magnesium Citrate, Magnesium Oxide, Zinc Citrate and Vitamin B6 in high concentrations makes our proprietary ZMB formula the most optimal for the body. Increasing the production of your own testosterone during the night to 40% and growth hormone to 20% will be responsible for increasing muscle mass, reducing body fat and improving training effects.

GABA

It is formed as a result of the decarboxylation of glutamic acid. GABA acid has the most significant impact on sleep and body regeneration during sleep. It affects the body's relaxation and increases the level of natural growth hormone. Thanks to GABA acid, sleep is more profound, the brain is more regenerated, and the whole body is much more relaxed and ready to work after a good night’s sleep. In addition, it stabilises blood pressure and reduces the risk of cramps.

Melatonin

Known as the “sleep hormone”, it is produced mainly at night. After puberty, the human body produces a reduced amount of melatonin naturally, so it’s worth supplementing this hormone before bedtime. Melatonin regulates the biological rhythm, makes sleep harder, lowers blood pressure, and thus we feel better after a recovery. Works synergistically with GABA acid. An additional advantage of melatonin is its effectiveness in removing free radicals. It is a powerful antioxidant that protects the body against various diseases.

N-Acetyl L-Cysteine ​​(NAC)

Cysteine ​​sulfuric acid. Cysteine ​​is part of structural proteins. Has very strong antioxidant properties. It cleanses the body of toxins and free radicals. Participates in the process of glutathione synthesis. The strongest antioxidant of the human body. Glutathione rebuilds muscle proteins. Has anabolic and antioxidant properties. Cysteine ​​is especially useful for intensive training and people exposed to stress.

Vitamin E

Affects physiological processes. Supports protection against free radicals, making an excellent addition to the strong antioxidant, Cysteine. Positively affects the nervous system and sexual performance. It is very good for people who often use computers, mobile phones and other devices that emit electromagnetic fields. Vitamin E creates a natural protective barrier for our cells.

The 7 most valuable ingredients that make up the irreplaceable set of night regeneration for your body. The most complete product for the night is available on the Polish market.

Description

Benefits of ZMA with Melatonin & GABA

  • Improved sleep quality
    Melatonin and GABA work synergistically to help you fall asleep faster, sleep deeper, and wake up feeling more refreshed.

  • Hormonal support
    ZMA (a blend of Zinc, Magnesium, and Vitamin B6) helps maintain healthy testosterone levels and supports hormone regulation, significant for athletes and active individuals.

  • Enhanced muscle recovery
    Zinc and Magnesium contribute to faster muscle repair and reduced post-workout soreness, while GABA promotes relaxation and deeper recovery during sleep.

  • Boosts natural growth hormone production
    Deep sleep stages stimulated by GABA and Melatonin are linked to increased natural growth hormone release, supporting muscle growth and fat metabolism.

  • Stress and anxiety reduction
    GABA is a natural calming neurotransmitter that helps lower stress and anxiety, promoting a more balanced mood and better sleep onset.

  • Immune system support
    Zinc and Magnesium play a crucial role in strengthening immune function, helping you stay healthy and recover more quickly from training or illness.

  • Improved sleep-wake cycle
    Melatonin helps regulate circadian rhythms, ideal for shift workers, travellers, or anyone struggling with sleep patterns.

Skull Labs Angel Dust PUMP Pre-Workout

Angel Dust Pump by Skull Labs is a new, supercharged pre-workout that promises an intense, muscle-pumping, and stimulating effect. This premium blend features a potent combination of DMHA and DMAA, supplemented with muscle-nourishing components such as agmatine, AAKG, and a substantial 6g of citrulline in each serving. Witness the invigorating effects of enhanced muscle fullness as your pump intensifies with each set, lasting throughout your rigorous workout regimen.

£55.00

Out of stock

Not available to buy online

Description

The Angel Dust Pump from Skull Labs is a new, puffy pre-workout that promises strong muscle pumping, a stimulating effect, and a nootropic benefit.
The advanced pre-workout formula is based on high-quality ingredients that stimulate, pump, strengthen training endurance and intensify fat burning.
Angel Dust Pump is a powerful pre-workout for individuals who prefer strong stimulant ingredients. As for the stimulating ingredients, Angel Dust Pump contains 100mg DMAA, 100mg DMHA, and 200mg Éria Jarensis Extract in one dose, thanks to which the stimulating effect is powerful.

Thanks to the high content of substances designed to pump muscles, Angel Dust Pump can induce a maximum pumping effect after only a few initial series, which persists throughout the training.
For maximum muscle pumping, Angel Dust Pump contains up to 6000mg of Citrulline Malate, 2500mg of Beta Alanine, 2000mg of Arginine AKG (AAKG), 2000mg of Agmatine Sulfate, and 1000mg of Creatine Nitrate.

Warning

Intended for persons over 18 years of age. Not suitable for breastfeeding and nursing women. Consult with your doctor or a nutrition expert before using the supplement if you have any of the following conditions or difficulties: high or low blood pressure, heart arrhythmia, any heart problems, liver dysfunction or problems, diabetes, mental disorders, prostate or breathing problems. DO NOT COMBINE WITH ALCOHOL AND DRUGS! Reduce caffeine intake from other sources (e.g. coffee, tea, etc.). Not intended as a substitute for a varied and diverse diet. Store in a dry place and out of reach of small children. Before use, study the instructions for use (label) and follow the recommended dosage.

Description

SLEEP-ER is powerful and comprehensive night regeneration supplement which contains melatonin, D-aspartic acid (DAA) and gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), extracts of valerian and lemon balm, magnesium which helps reduce tiredness and fatigue and vitamin B6 which contributes to regulation of the hormonal activity and proper functioning of the nervous system. Zinc contained in the product helps maintain normal levels of testosterone in the blood. SLEEP-ER is recommended for active athletes and those suffering intense physical or mental fatigue who do not regenerate completely during sleep.

 

Recommended daily portion is 9 g / 1,5 scoops

Usage

Dissolve one serving 9 g (1,5 scoops) in 150-200 ml of water and drink 30 min before bedtime.
